stem: $A$ and $B$ lie on circle $M$. Set the arc $AB$ facing $C$ to $140°$, and read the inscribed angle.
solution: Drag $B$ until the arc $AB$ that $C$ faces measures $140°$.
The central angle $\angle AMB$ is the same $140°$ — a central angle equals its arc.
The inscribed angle $\angle ACB$ then reads $70°$, exactly half.
That 2:1 relationship is the theorem, and it holds for every position of $C$ on that arc.
